categories.main_business_segments: The company specializes in the research, development, production and sales of optical lens products. Primary business segments include: (1) Security and surveillance lenses for public safety applications; (2) Automotive optical products including vehicle-mounted lenses, HUD optical components, and lidar optical elements; (3) Smart home and consumer optical products; (4) Industrial machine vision lenses; and (5) Emerging optical applications including photography equipment, projection optics, and thermal imaging lenses.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced optical design and manufacturing technologies including: precision glass and plastic aspheric lens manufacturing, optical coating processes, automated production equipment, and self-developed domestic alternative equipment. Key technological breakthroughs include HUD free-form surface production, lidar mirror manufacturing, infrared sulfide lens production, and domestic optical material substitution. The company utilizes both in-house manufacturing and outsourced processing for lower-value components.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers include leading security companies (Hikvision, Dahua), automotive manufacturers (BYD, Geely), and technology companies. End markets served include: public safety and surveillance systems, advanced driver assistance systems (ADAS), autonomous vehicles, smart home devices, machine vision systems, video conferencing, live streaming, 3C consumer electronics, and thermal imaging applications.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in mainland China with major facilities in Dongguan and Shangrao. International presence includes a Hong Kong subsidiary (Yuhao Technology). Domestic revenue represents 89.41% of total revenue while international markets account for 10.59%, with expansion efforts targeting Southeast Asia, South Asia, and Latin America.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the midstream to downstream segments of the optical supply chain. It manufactures finished optical lens products and optical components for integration into end-user devices and systems. The company sources raw materials (glass, plastic, coatings) from suppliers and sells finished products directly to major OEMs and system integrators.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include: (1) Deepening security surveillance lens market leadership; (2) Rapid expansion of automotive optical products including ADAS lenses, HUD components, and lidar optics; (3) Domestic optical material substitution to reduce import dependence; (4) Product miniaturization and performance enhancement; (5) Expansion into emerging applications including thermal imaging, AR/VR, and medical optics; (6) International market development; and (7) Talent cultivation through vocational education partnerships.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through direct sales of optical lens products and optical components to original equipment manufacturers and system integrators. Revenue is recognized when customers obtain control of goods, typically upon delivery and customer confirmation. The company maintains direct sales relationships with major customers and participates in industry exhibitions for market development.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as the world's largest security surveillance lens manufacturer with nine consecutive years of market share leadership in China's security lens market. Key competitors include other optical lens manufacturers, though the company maintains competitive advantages through scale, customer relationships with industry leaders (Hikvision, Dahua), product quality, and technical support. The company faces increasing competition in automotive optics from both domestic and international suppliers.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company is a mid-sized optical manufacturer with 2023 revenue of 2.145 billion yuan, representing 16.19% growth from 2022. However, net profit declined 78.60% to 30.85 million yuan due to industry competition, price pressure, and margin compression. The company has grown from 2.062 billion yuan revenue in 2021. Operating cash flow improved to 546.21 million yuan in 2023. Total assets reached 5.056 billion yuan with shareholder equity of 1.881 billion yuan.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates through: (1) Market-leading position in security surveillance lenses with comprehensive product portfolio; (2) Advanced optical design and manufacturing capabilities enabling high-performance, miniaturized products; (3) Strong customer relationships with industry leaders providing stable demand; (4) Continuous innovation in emerging applications (automotive, thermal imaging, AR/VR); (5) Domestic optical material substitution reducing supply chain risks; (6) Comprehensive technical support and customization capabilities; and (7) Vertical integration combining lens manufacturing with optical component production.
